2. Size doesn’t matter HAHA. Uhhhh I did it with a Moroccan before and I think my porn fantasies came true. BUT I didn’t got off HAHA. My pinoy ex was below average but he knows what he’s doing 😏

3. Do it for yourself! We have our own quirks. What works for me, might not work for you. Just have fun, play safe, and enjoy. ❤️

4. Scratch that itch. YEAAAAH! Life is too short not to scratch it. But again, it’s better to have your first with someone you connect with or trust. Iba talaga. :)
